tour.title: Project Introduction
tour.description: The HMU student email management system is a Maven-based Java web application. It manages the lifecycle of student institutional emails, including creation, activation, suspension, and deletion. The pom.xml file defines dependencies like MySQL for data storage, Apache POI for Excel processing, and JavaMail for communication.

tour.title: Authentication Flow
tour.description: The system handles authentication for both administrators and students. LoginServlet manages the login logic, verifying credentials against the database via DAOs. The login.jsp provides the user interface for entry into the system.

tour.title: Main Dashboard
tour.description: The admin dashboard is the central hub for account management. DashboardServlet retrieves system statistics and logs, which are rendered by dashboard.jsp. Interactive features like account searching and status updates are handled by main.js via AJAX calls.

tour.title: Data Management & Synchronization
tour.description: Core business logic for student and email data is encapsulated in StudentDAO. For bulk operations, ImportExcelServlet utilizes Apache POI to parse student lists from Excel files. The system also includes SyncSSOServlet to simulate synchronization with Single Sign-On providers.

tour.title: Utility Services
tour.description: The system relies on utility services for automated tasks. AccountGenerator provides logic for creating standardized institutional email addresses and secure default passwords. EmailService handles the delivery of welcome messages and password recovery instructions using the JavaMail API.
